fact: The ECOWAS Commission held a workshop in Accra on 3-5 February 2026 to validate the draft final report on the review of implementation of Regulation C/REG.21/12/17 on roaming, stating over half of Member States have implemented at least one bilateral roaming agreement.
title: ECOWAS Validates Implementation Review of its Regulation on Roaming
publisher: Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)
